desc: Implement binary-search feasibility check using the first K and last K elements with integer comparison 2*A[i] <= A[N-K+i].
Read input efficiently and output only the final answer.
Validate edge cases: N=2, all equal sizes, strictly increasing sizes, duplicates, odd/even N, and cases where no pair is possible.
If binary-search feasibility has any issue, implement the split two-pointer greedy as an alternative.
